source_primary_counting: at most one spike per cluster per20ms frame
alternative_multiplicity: not the primary; diagnostic reference only

serialization.linear_position: One ASCII floating scalar per line, no header; 50Hz order.
serialization.spikes: One plain nonnegative decimal integer per line, no header;20kHz ticks.
serialization.clusters: First plain integer is cluster-count header; remaining one plain integer label per corresponding spike record.
serialization.cell_classes: Noheader;one class token per nonblankline;whitespace trimmed;order retained.
serialization.session_shifts: Noheader;one exact integer-valued numeric timestamp per nonblankline;decimal/scientific notation supported;24kHz clock.
serialization.behavior: UTF8/BOM-compatible,headered comma CSV;standard quoting;exacteightcolumns in behavior_columns.
